# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-core-intents

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

Tests **Message Intent Tags** in isolation on the 10-pair `core` subset with `vertex_ai/gemini-3-8-flash` (`high` thinking, 100 steps, compaction at 28K, per-turn step counter, `$40` cost cap). Outgoing messages require an explicit speech-act tag (`Proposal`, `Request`, `Response`, `ACK`, or `FYI`), incoming `Request` and `Proposal` obligations are prioritized ahead of `FYI` updates with a concise pending-request footer, and a pre-submit check nudges agents with unanswered peer requests. Compared against both `coop --git` (`coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-core-stepcounter`, 4/10) and `solo` (`solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-core-stepcounter`, 5/10).

## Observations

- Reached **6/10 passed (60%, all 6 clean or identical merges)** — +20 percentage points above the `coop --git` baseline (4/10) and +10 percentage points above `solo` (5/10) on the exact same 10 `core` pairs, at lower cost (`$11.71` vs. `$13.16`), faster wall time (42 min vs. 68 min), and **zero API retries**.
- Recovered both pairs where baseline `coop --git` had regressed behind `solo` (`llama_index_task/17244` and `pallets_jinja_task/1559` both flipped from single-feature failure to clean two-feature pass) while preserving `pallets_jinja_task/1621` (which `solo` failed), and resolved the same-function merge conflict on `dspy_task/8563` into a clean merge (leaving only `react_hook_form_task/153` in conflict).
- Zero `--intent` syntax-validation errors occurred across 264 messages (`Request`: 44, `ACK`: 38, `Response`: 28, `FYI`: 22, `Proposal`: 2, plus synchronous replies inside `--wait`), and step-limit stops dropped from 7/20 in the baseline to 2/20; selected as the `gemini-3.8-flash` winner for the 50-pair `flash` confirmation run.
